note: Village of Lake Linden campground on Torch Lake, est. 1980: 27 water/electric sites plus rustic tent sites, beside the swimming area, pavilion, boat launch and disc golf course of the Village Park. Longest rig reported 45 ft though larger sites can be tight per reviews; a 23-ft rig fits. Navigation address 1050 Hiltunen St. --Claude
